name: Vitest
summary: Vite-native test runner with a Jest-compatible API.
what_it_is: A unit test runner that reuses your Vite configuration and transform pipeline, with an API close enough to Jest that most test files need no changes, plus genuinely fast watch mode.
why_it_matters: Vitest removed the long-standing annoyance of maintaining a second, divergent build configuration purely for tests. If your project already uses Vite, there is very little argument for running Jest alongside it. The migration is usually far smaller than teams expect.
suitable_for: Any project already building with Vite
Migrating from Jest with minimal test rewrites
not_suitable_for: React Native projects, where Jest remains better supported
Codebases depending on Jest-specific plugins with no equivalent
verifiable_facts: Official docs state it reuses the project Vite configuration and offers a Jest-compatible API.
editorial_interpretation: That there is "very little argument" for running Jest alongside Vite.
context_dependent_guidance: Suitable: Any project already building with Vite
Suitable: Teams wanting fast watch-mode feedback
Suitable: Migrating from Jest with minimal test rewrites
Unsuitable: React Native projects, where Jest remains better supported

wrong_if: A reviewer judges the migration-cost claim unsupported.
